purpose: Reviewer-requested position-control analysis of evidence utilization in long-context MPDS generation.

design.execution_order: Block-randomized by replicate, then shuffled over all case-by-ordering cells within each block.

case_selection_rule.eligibility: Both frozen submitted evidence pools must contain exactly 500 records.
case_selection_rule.ranking: Descending combined character count of the two frozen submitted evidence files; no outcome score is used.

position_manipulation.source: Frozen submitted knowledge snapshots listed in audit/knowledge_snapshot_manifest.csv.
position_manipulation.partition_unit: Complete evidence-record text blocks, preserving every record byte sequence and original ID.
position_manipulation.partition_rule: For each case and scientist pool separately, split the canonical relevance-ranked record sequence into three contiguous blocks with deterministic minimum squared character imbalance.
position_manipulation.identity_control: Each record and each fixed block appears once at every position; only block order changes.
position_manipulation.persona_control: Persona synthesis always receives the canonical source snapshot. Only evidence presented during the six debate turns is reordered.
position_manipulation.header_policy: The identical canonical source header is retained in every ordering and excluded from block-utilization denominators.
position_manipulation.id_policy: Original record IDs are retained and never renumbered.

fixed_factors: case-specific simulation date, debate topic, user context, and situation file
canonical persona-synthesis evidence and persona prompt
the exact evidence-record multiset and record IDs
two-persona MPDS architecture and three debate rounds
model, backend, location, temperature, and output-token limit
generation.only_manipulated_factor: The front, middle, or rear position of each fixed evidence block during debate turns.

primary_metrics: unique cited papers from each fixed block
citation occurrences from each fixed block
citation share from each fixed block
unique and occurrence utilization in the final moderator synthesis
analysis_lock.primary_analysis_unit: Case-level position means after averaging three stochastic replicates and the two scientist pools/fixed blocks nested within case.
analysis_lock.descriptive_unit: Fixed case-pool-block shown at front, middle, and rear under cyclic rotation.
analysis_lock.secondary_evaluation_scope: Final moderator synthesis only; personas and debate transcript are excluded.

interpretation.utilization_only: Positional utilization bias with limited effect on final hypothesis quality.
interpretation.no_material_difference: No substantial position effect observed in the tested long-context subset.
